content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having difficulty figuring out how to program the system so I can set the counter ON value by using a digital input. Is this achievable? Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you.
If you need to define the ON value of a counter while the program is running, this value should be referenced. For example, you can use an arithmetic instruction and trigger it with a digital signal.
